coupling_convention: f_a in GeV vs epsilon (dimensionless tuning parameter)
notes: This paper constrains exceptionally light QCD axions via white dwarf mass-radius relation. The exclusion is presented in the (f, epsilon) plane and (f, m_a) plane, not a standard coupling-vs-mass exclusion. The main quantitative results are: 2e-20 < epsilon < 2e-7 (95% CL) and 5.5e9 < f/GeV < 1.1e16 (95% CL), plus 33 <= N <= 69 for the Z_N model. These are intervals in the axion decay constant f and tuning parameter epsilon, not standard (mass_eV, coupling) pairs. The relation m_a^2 = epsilon * m_pi^2 f_pi^2 / f^2 links epsilon, f, and m_a but no explicit (m_a, f) exclusion table is given. Cannot faithfully produce standard data_points format; coupling type does not cleanly map to enum options (it's an f_a vs epsilon/m_a bound). AxionMass chosen as closest match but data extraction unreliable.
